message: Namaste Priya! You told us your back aches after cooking. Today, try the cat-cow back stretch after you finish in the kitchen. Get on your hands and knees on a folded blanket. Breathe in and let your belly drop gently. Breathe out and round your back up. Do this 5 times, slowly. If your knees hurt, put a pillow under them. Ask someone at home to stay close by. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or see any bleeding, and go to your nearest health centre or call 108 right away. For other questions, reply here to talk to a Noora nurse. Were you able to try it today? Reply 1 for Yes, 2 for No.
